items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-153 (includes BlockStrap RCE)
items.summary: This update addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including five critical ones. The most severe, CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap), is a template engine injection allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution with a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146 (StyleSmuggler RCE)
items.summary: This is an emergency hotfix for StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) with a CVSS score of 10.0. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including stored cross-site scripting (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201) and incorrect authorization flaws. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover (APSB26-92)
items.summary: This update fixes seven vulnerabilities, five of which are critical. It includes CVE-2026-71362, an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1, which allows attackers to switch a customer session to another account.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73 (14 flaws)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 14 vulnerabilities, marking the first month-stamped releases for fixes. The highest severity vulnerability in this bulletin was rated Critical.
